layout.arrangement: No top title bar. A top band (y≈5–22%) holds three clusters: input data table at far left, Initial-W vector plus the red REPEAT instruction at center, and the Check-classes Z table with the positive/negative/unaccepted note at right. Below, the left third (y≈30–66%) holds the Augmented-vectors matrix and a red-boxed 'Iteration 1' header. The right two-thirds (y≈27–97%) are filled by six stacked boxed calculation rows. A yellow slide-number badge sits in the extreme top-right corner.

layout.hierarchy: The six calculation rows dominate by area and repetition. Red accents (class labels, REPEAT line, Iteration-1 box, action phrases) are the secondary focus. The yellow '48' badge is tiny but high-contrast. Math uses italic variables with tall bracket vectors; everything is left-aligned within its cluster.

visual_elements.description: Input data table. Columns headed x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 x6. Rows: (1 2 1 5 6 6), (1 1 2 4 5 6), (1 2 2 4 5 6). Bottom row of class labels in red: C1 C1 C1 C2 C2 C2.
Check-classes table headed Z1 Z2 Z3 with two rows: (0 7 3) and (0 6 2). Sits under the caption 'Check classes of'.
Augmented-vectors matrix headed x1–x6. Rows: (1 1 1 1 1 1) bias, (1 2 1 5 6 6), (1 1 2 4 5 6); bottom red class row C1 C1 C1 C2 C2 C2.
Red-outlined, white-filled rectangle containing red text 'Iteration 1'.

Six stacked boxed derivation rows (no shared gridlines; each row its own light box). Columns per row: d(xᵢ) expression (1×3 row vector times current 3×1 W), scalar result, ⇒, action phrase, resulting W column vector. Row1: d(x₁)=[1 1 1]·[4;-2;-2]=0 ⇒ Update Weight; W=[4;-2;-2]+1·[1;1;1]=[5;-1;-1]. Row2: d(x₂)=[1 2 1]·[5;-1;-1]=2 ⇒ Keep same Weight; W=[5;-1;-1]. Row3: d(x₃)=[1 1 2]·[5;-1;-1]=2 ⇒ Keep same Weight; W=[5;-1;-1]. Row4: d(x₄)=[1 5 4]·[5;-1;-1]=-4 ⇒ Keep same Weight; W=[5;-1;-1]. Row5: d(x₅)=[1 6 5]·[5;-1;-1]=-6 ⇒ Keep same Weight; W=[5;-1;-1]. Row6: d(x₆)=[1 6 6]·[5;-1;-1]=-7 ⇒ Keep same Weight; W=[5;-1;-1].
Green double-lined left arrow (⇐) at the right edge of the first calculation row, pointing at its result W=[5;-1;-1].

imagery: White mouse-pointer cursor icon near the word 'unaccepted' in the top-right note, indicating a live screen capture.
typography_notes: Sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like) throughout. Variables W, d, x are italicized; x carries subscript numerals (x₁…x₆). Column vectors use tall square brackets with entries stacked. 'REPEAT' and 'Iteration 1' are all-caps. Class labels C1/C2, the words 'Zero' and 'REPEAT using Step η = 1', and the Iteration-1 box are red; action phrases 'Update Weight'/'Keep same Weight' are dark red/maroon; the ⇒ and ⇐ glyphs are used for implication and the green pointer. No serif text is present.
animation_state: No build animation is evident; all six calculation rows and both matrices are fully revealed. The mouse cursor near 'unaccepted' suggests a live screen capture rather than a partial build.
recreation_brief: 1) Set the slide background to white (#FFFFFF) and use a sans-serif font such as Arial. 2) Top-left (x≈4–30%, y≈5–22%): build a table headed x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 x6 with rows (1 2 1 5 6 6), (1 1 2 4 5 6), (1 2 2 4 5 6), then a final row C1 C1 C1 C2 C2 C2 in red #FF0000. 3) Top-center (x≈31–50%, y≈6–14%): place italic 'W' as a tall-bracket column vector labeled 'Initial W =' with entries 4, -2, -2. 4) Just right of it (x≈50–63%, y≈6–16%): add red text 'REPEAT using Step η = 1'. 5) Top-right (x≈63–91%, y≈5–22%): add caption 'Check classes of', a small table headed Z1 Z2 Z3 with rows (0 7 3) and (0 6 2), and below it the sentence 'C1 positive, C2 negative, Zero is unaccepted' with C1, C2 and 'Zero' in red. 6) Extreme top-right (x≈92–98%, y≈2–8%): draw a yellow #FFFF00 circle with a thin black border containing '48'. 7) Mid-left (x≈4–30%, y≈30–52%): add the header 'Ugmented Vectors (from Top)' (keep the misspelling), then a matrix headed x1–x6 with rows (1 1 1 1 1 1), (1 2 1 5 6 6), (1 1 2 4 5 6) and a red class row C1 C1 C1 C2 C2 C2. 8) Below it (x≈7–28%, y≈56–66%): draw a red-bordered white box with red text 'Iteration 1'. 9) Right/center (x≈33–97%, y≈27–97%): draw six stacked light-blue boxes (fill #E9F2F9, thin border #8FB3CC). In each box place, left to right, the d(xᵢ) dot product (1×3 row vector times the current 3×1 W), the scalar result, a ⇒ glyph, the action phrase in dark red #8B0000, and the resulting W column vector, using exactly: row1 d(x₁)=[1 1 1]·[4;-2;-2]=0, 'Update Weight', W=[4;-2;-2]+1·[1;1;1]=[5;-1;-1]; rows 2–6 'Keep same Weight' with W=[5;-1;-1] and results 2, 2, -4, -6, -7 for d(x₂)=[1 2 1], d(x₃)=[1 1 2], d(x₄)=[1 5 4], d(x₅)=[1 6 5], d(x₆)=[1 6 6]. 10) Add a green #1E8449 double arrow ⇐ at the right edge of row 1 pointing to its W=[5;-1;-1]. 11) Place a standard white mouse-cursor icon near 'unaccepted'. 12) Italicize W, d and x, subscript the x indices, and keep 'REPEAT' and 'Iteration 1' in caps.
